Posterior model evidence and SBM model class selection

compare_model_classes.Rd

Declarative, callback-free Bayesian model class selection across flat, hierarchical (nested), degree-corrected, non-degree-corrected, and overlapping stochastic block models. Computes both MAP description lengths and full posterior marginal log-evidences \(\ln P(A | \mathcal{M})\), posterior model weights, and pairwise log Bayes factors.

Usage

model_evidence(state, nsamples = 200L, thin = 5L, burnin = NULL,
  beta = 1, mle = TRUE, method = c("variational", "importance"),
  samples = NULL, entropies = NULL, multiflip = TRUE,
  c = 0.5, d = 0.01, B_min = 1L, B_max = Inf)
compare_model_classes(graph,
  models = c("flat_ndc", "flat_dc", "nested_ndc", "nested_dc",
    "overlap_flat_ndc", "overlap_flat_dc",
    "overlap_nested_ndc", "overlap_nested_dc"),
  degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  method = c("map", "posterior"),
  evidence_method = c("variational", "importance"),
  nruns = 1L, nsamples = 200L, thin = 5L, burnin = NULL, mle = TRUE,
  B_min = 1L, B_max = Inf, refine = TRUE)

Arguments

state

A fitted rgraphtool_block_state, rgraphtool_nested_block_state, rgraphtool_overlap_block_state, rgraphtool_nested_overlap_block_state, rgraphtool_weighted_block_state, rgraphtool_nested_weighted_block_state, rgraphtool_layered_block_state, rgraphtool_nested_layered_block_state, rgraphtool_pp_block_state, rgraphtool_ranked_block_state, or rgraphtool_nested_ranked_block_state object.

graph

A graph created by graph_create.

models

Character vector naming a subset of the 8 SBM model classes: "flat_ndc", "flat_dc", "nested_ndc", "nested_dc", "overlap_flat_ndc", "overlap_flat_dc", "overlap_nested_ndc", and "overlap_nested_dc".

degree_prior

Degree sequence hyperprior ("distributed" or "uniform").

method

For compare_model_classes(), rank models by "map" minimum description length or full Bayesian "posterior" marginal evidence. For model_evidence(), choose between "variational" (\(\ln P(A) = -\langle \Sigma \rangle + H(b)\)) and "importance" (Peixoto 2021 Eq. 29 mode-mixture importance sampling).

evidence_method

Evidence estimator forwarded to model_evidence() when method = "posterior".

nruns

Number of independent minimization restarts per model class, retaining the lowest description length fit.

nsamples

Number of thinned posterior samples to collect.

thin

Number of MCMC sweeps between collected samples.

burnin

Number of burn-in sweeps before sampling, or NULL to equilibrate automatically (flat/nested) or use 30 sweeps (overlap).

beta

Inverse temperature (default 1).

mle

Whether to use MLE or Dirichlet(1) posterior mean marginals for posterior entropy and mode log-probabilities.

samples, entropies

Optional pre-collected posterior partition samples and matching description lengths (e.g. from sample_posterior), avoiding redundant MCMC runs.

multiflip

Whether to use merge-split MCMC moves for flat/nested states.

c, d

MCMC proposal mixing and empty-group parameters.

B_min, B_max

Minimum and maximum number of level-0 groups.

refine

Whether to run refinement sweeps during minimization.

Details

For a given model class, model_evidence() equilibrates an MCMC chain, collects posterior partition samples and exact description lengths \(\Sigma(b^{(m)})\) natively in C++, clusters the samples into posterior modes via mode_cluster_state, and computes both the variational evidence \(\ln P(A) = -\langle \Sigma \rangle + H_{\mathrm{posterior}}\) (matching graph-tool's model class selection cookbook) and Peixoto's (2021) mode-mixture importance estimate \(-\ln P(A) = \ln\!\left(\frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^M \exp(\Sigma(b^{(m)}) + \ln q(b^{(m)}))\right)\).

Note that for overlapping states, the posterior partition entropy is estimated from per-vertex majority-group samples rather than full half-edge trajectories, providing a conservative lower bound on the half-edge posterior entropy.

Value

model_evidence() returns a rgraphtool_model_evidence list with log_evidence, neg_log_evidence, variational_log_evidence, importance_log_evidence, mean_dl, sd_dl, map_dl, posterior_entropy, cluster, samples, entropies, and state.

compare_model_classes() returns a rgraphtool_model_class_comparison list with ranked summary data frame, best_model, best_state, named list of fitted states, optional evidences, and pairwise log_bayes_factors matrix.

References

Peixoto, T. P. (2015). Model selection and hypothesis testing for large-scale network models with overlapping groups. Physical Review X 5, 011033.

Peixoto, T. P. (2021). Revealing consensus and dissensus between network partitions. Physical Review X 11, 021003.

See also

overlap_block_state, mode_cluster_state, sample_posterior, demo("model_class_selection")

Examples

g <- graph_create(n = 12L, directed = FALSE)
edges <- rbind(
  t(utils::combn(1:6, 2)),
  t(utils::combn(7:12, 2)),
  c(6, 7)
)
graph_add_edges(g, edges)
set.seed(42)
cmp <- compare_model_classes(g, models = c("flat_ndc", "flat_dc",
                                           "nested_ndc", "overlap_flat_ndc"))
cmp
#> <SBM model class comparison (MAP description length, distributed degree prior)>
#>             model B levels description_length delta posterior_weight
#>  overlap_flat_ndc 2      1             50.159 0.000           0.8620
#>          flat_ndc 2      1             52.477 2.318           0.0849
#>        nested_ndc 2      5             53.170 3.011           0.0424
#>           flat_dc 2      1             54.553 4.394           0.0106
#> Best model: overlap_flat_ndc
